label: D1 reward-seen, late in episode (esp. after rare-rewarded trials)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass), almost only when the reward input is 1 (95% of mass). Within rewarded D1 steps it is gated by episode time: it is silent before trial ~10, rare before ~60, and 63% of mass falls in trials 90-99 (rate 6.8x). It is boosted when the rewarded previous trial was a rare transition (prev_common==0, 2.2x lift; top activations are D1 after rare-rewarded trials late in the episode). It tracks low value-head output (value<5.22 bin holds 66% of mass), which likely reflects the same late-episode drift. Predicate (rewarded D1, and either trial>=90 or rare-previous with trial>=60) gets dev F1 0.42, mass recall 0.86, but precision is only 0.28: many rewarded late D1 steps stay below threshold, so magnitude probably encodes a graded episode-time / rare-reward signal. Never fires at GO or D2, nor on unrewarded D1. Uses only observed variables (ep_trial is an internal clock the GRU can integrate).
